name: sam-gov
description: Keyless-first MCP server + Skill workflow guide for US federal and state/local (SLED) government contracting, spending, regulation and partner vetting — 152 tools over 54 public data sources (SAM.gov, USAspending, Federal Register, eCFR, Grants.gov and more); 147 tools need no API key, 5 need a free one. Independent project, not affiliated with or endorsed by SAM.gov or the U.S. GSA.
